output.summary: Annual flowering herb native to temperate and boreal North America and Eurasia, usually growing beside ponds, streams and other wet ground. It has deeply divided, mostly hairless leaves and small yellow flowers. All parts are considered poisonous, and ingestion can cause burning, pain, tongue inflammation and increased salivation.
output.edibilityNote: All parts are considered poisonous; ingestion can irritate the skin and mucous membranes.
